entries.title: Forgive Me Father
entries.definitive_edition: Forgive Me Father on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it is the original full-release platform with PC capture/settings flexibility, while the PS4, Xbox One, and Switch ports do not have platform-exclusive campaign content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Forgive Me Father on Steam, GOG, or another PC storefront and play the current Windows PC build.

all_releases.reason: primary: original full-release route with highest capture/settings flexibility.

all_releases.fidelity: Console port; playable on PS5 through compatibility rather than a sourced separate PS5 release.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced platform-exclusive campaign content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Console port; playable on Xbox Series X/S through backward compatibility rather than a sourced separate Series release.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced platform-exclusive campaign content over PC.
skip: portable route, but no sourced platform-exclusive campaign content over PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No console-exclusive content is documented; the Windows PC release remains the straightforward highest-flexibility route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or expansion edition is documented.
